scripts.check: pnpm run bindings && pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.fmt: prettier --write package.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json tsconfig.base.json apps packages --ignore-unknown && cargo fmt --all
